title: El Niño, heat extremes, drought and mortality in India, 2001–2024: data and code
description:
Data and code for a study of the El Niño–Southern Oscillation and recorded heat/sun-stroke deaths (2001–2024), farming-sector suicides (2001–2023) and foodgrain production (1997–2016) in 34 Indian state-level units, with projections for 2027 (manuscript under review).

Contents: state × year panels compiled from the National Crime Records Bureau's Accidental Deaths & Suicides in India (2001–2024 editions), the Open Government Data Platform India, a Ministry of Earth Sciences annexure (cross-check), the Reserve Bank of India Handbook of Statistics on Indian States and the ICRISAT-TCI District Level Database (cross-check), with every parsed record, source precedence and reviewed exceptions (including the printed-zero rule for farmer suicides); population denominators (Census of India, official projections); ENSO indices (NOAA CPC, NOAA PSL); IMD-based climate exposures pooled to the 34 units; model-ready inputs; the Python pipeline that builds them from the official sources; and the R analysis (glmmTMB negative binomial mixed models, leave-one-El-Niño-out and rolling-origin validation, mediation, 2027 projections) with its results and supplementary tables. Farmer-suicide data are aggregated state-year counts only; see the responsible-reporting note in README.md. Raw source files are not redistributed; their public URLs and SHA-256 checksums are listed.
